query:
update tournaments
           set max_participants = $2, champion_rules = $3, map_mode = $4, champion_phase = $5,
               veto_seconds = $6, mode = $7, team_size = $8, team_pick_seconds = $9,
               veto_order = $10, pick_order = $11, veto_by = $12, ban_by = $13, pick_by = $14,
               report_by = $15
           where id = $1
